thing-type.label: Area Thing
thing-type.description: Area / partition. Arming uses createCC.A_SET / A_UNSET / A_PARTSET control sessions.

parameter.name: number
parameter.label: Area Number
parameter.description: Unique number identifying the area/partition on the ATS Advanced Panel

channel-type.label: Set
channel-type.description: Fully set (arm) or unset the area (createCC.A_SET / A_UNSET)

channel-type.label: Force Set
channel-type.description: Force-arm the area (createCC.A_SET → fnCC.A_SET_FORCEDSET). ON only.

channel-type.label: Part Set
channel-type.description: Part-set the area (createCC.A_PARTSET). ON only; OFF unsets.

channel-type.label: Exit
channel-type.description: Area is in exit timer state

channel-type.label: Status
channel-type.description: Readable summary of active area flags

channel-type.label: Walk Test
channel-type.description: Start/stop walk-test for this area (createCC.A_WALKTST). ON=start, OFF=stop.

channel-type.label: Arm Preview
channel-type.description: Inhibit/block list before arming (createCC.A_STATE). Refresh to update.
